evals.prompt: I installed deeplethe/solid-glass into our Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui Base UI project, but the cards look flat and borders show a double ring.
evals.expected_output: Run `scripts/preflight.py` to check CSS import order and token collisions; verify `@import "./solid-glass.css";` comes after `tailwindcss`, `tw-animate-css`, and `shadcn/tailwind.css`, delete the `:root` and `.dark` color variables written by `shadcn init`, and remove extra Tailwind border classes on `bg-card`, `bg-popover`, or `glass-panel`.

evals.prompt: Which AI-specific UI components come in the Solid Glass registry, and how do I install them?
evals.expected_output: List the 12 Solid Glass AI components (`status-glyph`, `panel`, `tag`, `dot-loader`, `turn-status`, `composer`, `tool-steps`, `diff-view`, `ask-card`, `context-ring`, `task-notice`, `reasoning`) plus the `solid-glass` stylesheet, installed via `npx shadcn@latest add deeplethe/solid-glass/<name>`.

evals.prompt: How do I style an active/selected list item and a primary action button in Solid Glass, and disable backdrop blur on a dense code sidebar?
evals.expected_output: Use `glass-chosen` / `glass-held` for selected or open-menu triggers, `<Button variant="glass" data-strong>` for emphasized glass buttons, and `<aside data-glass="opaque">` to drop backdrop blur while retaining rim highlights, hairlines, and shadows.

evals.prompt: How do I change the Solid Glass accent color from green-teal to our product brand color?
evals.expected_output: Override `--brand`, `--brand-foreground`, and `--brand-muted` once in `:root` and `.dark` while keeping primary surfaces monochrome.

evals.prompt: Our React 19 app does not use Tailwind CSS or shadcn at all, and we want drop-in single-file TSX tool-call and decision-inbox components.
evals.expected_output: Route to `affectui` rather than `solid-glass`, explaining that `affectui` ships self-contained zero-Tailwind `.tsx` files while `solid-glass` requires Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui.
